reason: Actual entry witnesses show insufficient edge at unchanged size/dynamic threshold. Inspect lower existing bid levels without reducing either requirement.
quoteUniverse: First three displayed original bid levels per leg, join only, never synthetic price or future data
quantityRule: EXACT original min(orderShares,0.1*min(bestBidDepth)) rounded down .01; never increased, market minimum unchanged
dynamicRiskRule: EXACT original effective observed volatility/expiry/top-depth threshold; do not recompute lower premium using thicker deeper quote depth
ownLevelParticipationCap: At most 10% actual displayed size at selected quote
selectionRule: Maximize combined displayed bid, then minimize maximum level index, then index sum, then higher first-token bid
safetyRule: Actual freshness,metadata,remaining exit loss cap,account/portfolio budget,holdings/open-order/taker-source restrictions unchanged
scope: 34 actual legacy guarded DEVELOPMENT decision states only, not new account replay or performance
predeclaredNextGate: If no additional legal priced entry vs actual PAIR_SUBMITTED branches, reject without full tape scan. Otherwise only predeclare full-tape necessary-traffic screening; price feasibility alone never authorizes account promotion or independent capture.
